lines.text: You celebrate the Passover in the month of Abib, offering the sacrifice where the LORD will choose.
For seven days you eat unleavened bread, because you left the land of Egypt in haste.
The Passover sacrifice is offered in the evening as the sun sets, at the time they left Egypt.
Israel counts seven weeks from the first sickle in the grain, then celebrates the Feast of Trumpets.
Three times a year all the priests must appear before the LORD in the place He will choose.
